questions.question: India becomes __________ nation having capabilities to shoot down fixed wing drone by laser beam.
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Fourth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India becomes 4th nation having capabilities to shoot down fixed wing drone by laser beam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India** successfully showcased its ability to shoot down **fixed-wing aircraft, missiles, and swarm drones** using a **30-kilowatt laser-based weapon system**.

 
 
• 
 
This achievement places India in an exclusive group of countries, including **US, China**, and **Russia**, with such a capability.

 
 
• 
 
The **successful trial** was conducted by the **Centre for High Energy Systems & Sciences (CHESS)** at **Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh**.

 
 
• 
 
The weapon system used in the trial:

 
 
• 
 
**Vehicle-mounted Laser Directed Energy Weapon (DEW MK-II(A))**.

 
 
• 
 
Successfully **disabled drones** and **fixed-wing UAVs**, causing **structural damage** and **disabling surveillance sensors**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
India now joins the global powers with **high-power Laser DEW Systems**.

 
 
• 
 
DRDO is also working on **other high-energy technologies** like:

 
 
• 
 
**High-energy microwaves**

 
 
• 
 
**Electromagnetic pulse**

 
 
• 
 
Technologies with **Star Wars-like capabilities**.

questions.question: What is the weight class of the Long-Range Glide Bomb Gaurav?

The Correct Answer is ​__**1000 kilograms**__.

• DRDO Successfully Tests Long-Range Glide Bomb ‘Gaurav’ from Su-30 MKI Aircraft.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** successfully conducted the **release trials** of the **Long-Range Glide Bomb Gaurav** from the **Su-30 MKI aircraft**.

 
 
• 
 
**Gaurav** is a **1000-kilogram class glide bomb**.

 
 
• 
 
It was **indigenously designed and developed** by:

 
 
•

•

questions.question: Which Indian shipbuilding company designed the INS Arnala?

questions.question: Who is the first woman fighter pilot in the Indian Navy?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Aastha Poonia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Sub Lieutenant Aastha Poonia becomes Indian Navy’s first woman fighter pilot.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Sub Lieutenant Aastha Poonia** has become the **first woman fighter pilot** in the **Indian Navy**.

 
 
• 
 
She was awarded the **‘Wings of Gold’** at the **graduation ceremony** of the **Second Basic Hawk Conversion Course**.

 
 
• 
 
The ceremony took place at **INS Dega**, **Visakhapatnam.**

 
 
• 
 
The Indian Navy hailed it as **“a new chapter in Naval aviation”**, marking **gender progress in the fighter pilot domain**, traditionally male-dominated.

questions.question: In which military exercise did India participate for the first time in 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Talisman Sabre**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India joins bilateral military exercise in Australia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
India has participated for the first time in **Exercise Talisman Sabre**, Australia’s largest bilateral military drill.

 
 
• 
 
The exercise was launched in **2005** as a **biennial** joint military exercise between the **United States and Australia**.

 
 
• 
 
In **2025**, it involves **over 35,000 personnel** from **19 countries**.

 
 
• 
 
Participating nations include: United States, Australia, India, Canada, Fiji, France, Germany, Indonesia, Japan, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Papua New Guinea, Philippines, South Korea, Singapore, Thailand, Tonga, and the United Kingdom.

 
 
• 
 
**Malaysia and Vietnam** are attending as **observers**.

 
 
• 
 
The exercise will be held over **three weeks**, covering joint operations across **land, sea, and air** domains.

 
 
• 
 
India’s participation marks a step forward in strengthening **Indo-Pacific defence ties** and interoperability.

questions.question: In which region was Exercise Divya Drishti conducted?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**East Sikkim**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Indian Army tests AI, surveillance tech in high-altitude ‘Divya Drishti’ exercise in Sikkim.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Exercise Divya Drishti** was successfully conducted by the **Indian Army**.

 
 
• 
 
The exercise took place in **East Sikkim**, under **high-altitude operational conditions**.

 
 
• 
 
**Launched by**: **Trishakti Corps** of the Indian Army.

 
 
• 
 
Purpose: To test **AI-based battlefield awareness**, **real-time surveillance**, and **next-gen warfare technologies**.

 
 
• 
 
Used **ground-based platforms, drones, and UAVs** to simulate **operational missions**.

 
 
• 
 
Focus: To prepare for **hybrid warfare**, especially in **Himalayan conflict zones** and diverse terrains.

questions.question: What was the name of the counterterror operation in which Pahalgam attack mastermind killed?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Operation Mahadev**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Op Mahadev: Terrorist believed to be Pahalgam attack mastermind, 2 others killed in encounter near Srinagar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Operation Mahadev**: A joint counterterrorism operation by the **Indian Army** and **J&K Police** in **Srinagar**.

 
 
• 
 
**Three Pakistani terrorists** were killed in the **Dachigam area near Mount Mahadev**, Srinagar.

 
 
• 
 
Among them was **Suleiman Shah alias Musa Fauji**, a **top Lashkar-e-Taiba commander**.

 
 
• 
 
He was the **mastermind and executor** of the **Pahalgam terror attack**, which killed **26 civilians**.

 
 
• 
 
The name **“Mahadev”** was derived from the **Zabarwan–Mahadev ridgeline** near the encounter site.
